tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the source's --bg-gradient-bottom, light is the source's light --bg. Flat: the old radial teal glow is retired.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panels that earn elevation: case-study media frames, the open state of an expandable panel, the nav when scrolled. Source --bg-elevated.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: code and data callouts, the diagram canvas, tag fills. Addition.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on ground, surface-raised and surface-sunken. 13:1 or better in both themes. Source --text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, dates, captions and control borders on all three surfaces (5.1:1 minimum). Light value darkened from the source's #506a86 so it also clears 4.5:1 on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent. Marks, not paragraphs: diagram signal paths, timeline nodes, active nav underline, chart strokes. In light it is 4.1:1 on ground, so never set small text in it there; use accent-ink. Source --accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured TEXT: inline links, the one highlighted phrase in a lead, metric deltas. 7.3:1 or better on every surface. Light value is the source's --accent-strong.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover fills for action, and the accent block on the cover. Source --accent-strong.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Pair only with on-action text (7.4:1 in both themes). Addition, replacing the neumorphic white button.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and accent-strong fills.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one status colour: 'current' and 'in progress' only (the role you hold now, a credential awaiting confirmation). Text-safe on all surfaces (4.9:1 minimum). Source's .text-warning date colour; light value is an addition.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that organise content: timeline spine, section dividers, media frame edges. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control (use muted for that). Solid replacement for the source's rgba borders.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and selected edges on frames and rows. Replaces the source's --border-strong (teal at 35 to 45 percent).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset. 7:1 or better against every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy, constant in both themes. Hero slab and cover block in Day; in Night it sits within 1.1:1 of ground, so use slab there instead. Source --bg.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Brand mist, constant in both themes. Relief block, and text on navy (14.8:1). Source dark --text.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: The inverted block: the one large colour field per page (hero slab, cover block, case-study title band). Always paired with on-slab.

tokens.name: on-slab
tokens.usage: Text on slab. 14.8:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind the case-study dialog. Addition.

tokens.name: glow-a
tokens.usage: Ambient page glow, top left. Dark theme depth.

tokens.name: glow-b
tokens.usage: Ambient page glow, bottom right.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Completed status fill.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Completed status text.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: Completed status border.

tokens.name: wip-bg
tokens.usage: In progress status fill.

tokens.name: wip-ink
tokens.usage: In progress status text.

tokens.name: wip-line
tokens.usage: In progress status border.

tokens.name: mark-bg
tokens.usage: Highlighted key fact fill.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero name only. Steps to 48px under 768px.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Case-study titles and the one headline per major section. 36px under 768px.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: How the collar talks to the app
styles.usage: Chapter headings inside a case study, timeline year blocks.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Web Content Technologist, City of Brampton
styles.usage: Role lines, credential names, card titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I turn design files into accessible, working pages.
styles.usage: The first paragraph of the profile and of each case study. Max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rebuilt 65+ public-facing pages from scratch in SharePoint Online.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: One emphasised sentence per block. Replaces the old ats-highlight spans, which highlighted too much.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figure 2. Mobile dashboard showing tracking status.
styles.usage: Figure captions below media, footnotes, helper text.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Diagram node labels, edge labels, tech tags, dates on the timeline. Sentence case, not uppercase. Set in Geist with tabular figures; the site uses one type family.

styles.name: mono-data
styles.usage: Course codes, measured numbers and before/after values. Numbers are always mono. Set in Geist with tabular figures; the site uses one type family.

styles.name: mono-figure
styles.usage: The headline number in a MetricFigure. Only for figures the CV or a reference document supports. Set in Geist with tabular figures; the site uses one type family.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag and its neighbour, icon and label. Source.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside a block; the mobile side gutter. Source.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside raised panels; grid gutter. Source.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between headline and body; timeline entry spacing. Source.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between chapters inside a case study. Source.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile. Source.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop. Addition: the source's 3.5rem made every section feel like a list item.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: One deliberate pause per page, before the case studies. Addition.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, diagram nodes, the code well. Addition: annotation shapes stay crisp like a drawing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and dropdowns. Source.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Media frames, raised panels, the dialog. Source.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Device mockup outer shell only. Source.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, theme toggle, nav pill. Every interactive control is a pill; nothing else is. Source.

shadow.note: Tinted to the ground hue. Elevation is rare: frames lean on rule, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Scrolled nav, hovered media frame. Source.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The case-study dialog and device mockups. Source.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Outer page width. Raised from the source's 1100px (and the 900px main cap) so case studies get room for media beside copy.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for body copy.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Space taken by the floating pill navigation (10px offset plus a 58px pill), on all breakpoints.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Width of every rule.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Case-study dialog and its scrim. Source .modal.
